BEGIN PROMPT

PLAN 03 | A KING SENT BACK TO WORK

DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9

CHARACTER REFERENCES

{{CHAR_JAMSHID_WORKER}} @Jamshid (look 5)   {{CHAR_DOCK_WORKERS}} @Chinese People (look 1) @Chinese People (look 2)   {{CHAR_DOCK_FOREMAN}} @Chinese Foreman (look 1) 

LOCATION REFERENCES

{{LOC_WORKING_QUAY}} @Port Shipyard Hall (look 1)   {{LOC_PORT_PANORAMA}}

PROP REFERENCES

{{PROP_NET}}  {{PROP_CARGO_HOIST}}  {{PROP_MOORING_ROPE}}

DIRECTION AND CONTINUITY

Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence. Preserve each referenced identity, costume, proportions and rigid handmade mask; mask geometry and eye openings remain fixed. All visible humans wear their referenced masks. Emotion comes from posture, hands, breath and visible eyes. Each listed hard cut changes the physical camera station, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement follows a possible path and recovers focus on essential action. References anchor design; written lighting controls illumination. Tactile modern Iranian mythological design, analog realism and natural imperfections. NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

LOCATION AND LIGHT

Cold neutral overcast daylight throughout all four shots. Damp quay bounce, tactile net fibers and work-worn garments. No sunset, no lighting transition and no time-lapse.

START STATE AND BLOCKING

On the quay, the stabilized crate is completing its descent in the NORTH loading zone. Jamshid stands SOUTH of it beside the rope stations. The foreman approaches from WEST carrying the damaged fishing net. A net-repair position lies farther SOUTH.


PLAN 03 | SHOTS

SHOT 03-01 | 0s–3s | 3 SECONDS

35mm low lateral from WEST of the loading zone. The crate settles onto its support. Jamshid completes a small downward hand cue, then lets his hand fall. Workers release tension in order. No one crosses beneath the load.

SHOT 03-02 | 3s–6s | 3 SECONDS

50mm slightly low three-quarter from SOUTHEAST, facing Jamshid's left-front profile. Place him on the left third, dock structure rising behind. His spine straightens, chin lifts a little and his shoulders broaden with remembered authority. A restrained physical push recognizes his pride without centering him.

SHOT 03-03 | 6s–11s | 5 SECONDS

35mm waist-height from SOUTHWEST. Foreman enters from frame left, pushes the bundled net into Jamshid's chest and waiting hands, then delivers one brusque open-handed knock to his upper shoulder, directing him toward the repair station. Jamshid catches the net, stumbles one step and is sent out frame right. Camera is displaced slightly by their bodies.

SHOT 03-04 | 11s–15s | 4 SECONDS

65mm close oblique from beside the repair position, net strands soft in the foreground. Jamshid separates a tangled section and pulls a loop into order. His shoulders are folded again, hands still exact. Hold his suppressed response through a short stopped breath; he continues working.

END STATE AND EDIT

End in daylight on Jamshid working the net. A direct editorial time ellipsis leads to the night ship arrival; do not generate any day-to-night transition shots.

SOUND

Cargo landing, rope slack, net hitting clothing, one dull shoulder contact, continued work traffic and net fiber friction.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

END PROMPT
